scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && esbuild public/ts/filters.ts public/ts/menu.ts public/ts/tabs.ts public/ts/img-fallback.ts public/ts/scroll-top.ts public/ts/wheel.ts --outdir=public/js --target=ie11 --minify && node scripts/precompress.mjs && node -e "const{cpSync}=require('fs');cpSync('src/views','dist/views',{recursive:true});cpSync('public','dist/public',{recursive:true,filter:(s)=>!s.endsWith('.gz')&&!s.endsWith('.br')});console.log('dist assets copied')"
scripts.check: tsc -p tsconfig.json && eslint src server.ts scripts --ext .ts,.tsx,.mjs && npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=moderate
scripts.db:init: node -e "const{mkdirSync,existsSync}=require('fs');const D=require('better-sqlite3');if(!existsSync('prisma'))mkdirSync('prisma');new D('prisma/main.db').close();new D('prisma/web.db').close();" && drizzle-kit push --config=drizzle.main.config.ts --force && drizzle-kit push --config=drizzle.web.config.ts --force
scripts.db:seed: npx tsx prisma/seed-main.ts && npx tsx prisma/seed-web.ts
scripts.db:reset: npm run db:clear && npm run db:seed
